about: Road to 4.5, P3 (art and the first session): every art slot the P3 rows draw, with the REUSED painting it is cut from today (fallback) and, where a bespoke painting would beat the cut, the prompt tools/art/p3-gen.py paints it from. A slot's file always exists (the cut), so the app is complete before any painting does; p3-gen.py --paint replaces a cut in place, at the same path and the same pixel size. Boxes are fractions of the source (x0, y0, x1, y1). tests/p3-art.cjs holds every slot to its path, its size, its WebP and its prompt rules.
style: Warm painted storybook illustration for a children's spelling app, in the house style of its painted Atlas and Library: gouache and watercolour texture, soft golden light, honey and amber tones with gentle teal and violet accents, rich but calm, painterly anime background in the spirit of Studio Ghibli. Full-bleed edge to edge, no border, no frame, no vignette box.
never: ABSOLUTELY NO TEXT anywhere: no letters, no words, no numbers, no labels, no signs, no signage, no captions, no writing on books, spines, pages, cards, scrolls, banners, posters, boards, screens, keys or charts; no letter-shaped objects and no alphabet blocks; every surface that could carry writing is plain or blank. NO people, NO human figures, NO faces, NO hands. No logos and no brand marks.

slots.use: My Feed: a word's meaning (kind word) and a library word spotlight (kind spotlight)
slots.prompt: A wide, low banner scene: a cosy reading nook inside a giant honey-coloured hive, glowing hexagonal lamp-cells set into the walls, one large blank card resting on a little wooden lectern under a warm reading lamp, a magnifying glass beside it, drifting motes of golden light. The left third is calm and soft so text can sit near it.
